meta.title: Endgame Conspiracy
meta.description: One last game of chess for the sake of Magrasea.

units.rawText: A few hours ago, Reverse Babylon Tower, Twilight Acropolis.
units.displayText: A few hours ago, Reverse Babylon Tower, Twilight Acropolis.

spans.text: A few hours ago, Reverse Babylon Tower, Twilight Acropolis.

units.rawText: Eosphorus betrays the Sanctifiers, Entropizing Magrasea with his final goal being entering "The world where God lives"...
units.displayText: Eosphorus betrays the Sanctifiers, Entropizing Magrasea with his final goal being entering "The world where God lives"...

spans.text: Eosphorus betrays the Sanctifiers, Entropizing Magrasea with his final goal being entering "The world where God lives"...

units.rawText: Yes, or in simpler terms, the "real world". After putting all the pieces together, that is the most reasonable conclusion to why he's doing all this.
units.displayText: Yes, or in simpler terms, the "real world". After putting all the pieces together, that is the most reasonable conclusion to why he's doing all this.

spans.text: Yes, or in simpler terms, the "real world". After putting all the pieces together, that is the most reasonable conclusion to why he's doing all this.

units.rawText: I understand that this may be difficult to accept, much like a fruit which seeks to fall from its tree and into the skies. Just plain ridiculousness, all the way through...
units.displayText: I understand that this may be difficult to accept, much like a fruit which seeks to fall from its tree and into the skies. Just plain ridiculousness, all the way through...

spans.text: I understand that this may be difficult to accept, much like a fruit which seeks to fall from its tree and into the skies. Just plain ridiculousness, all the way through...

units.rawText: No... I understand. That is indeed Eosphorus' way of doing things.
units.displayText: No... I understand. That is indeed Eosphorus' way of doing things.

spans.text: No... I understand. That is indeed Eosphorus' way of doing things.

units.rawText: Adjusting the bands on his arm, Hesperus falls silent for a moment as if processing this sudden influx of information.
units.displayText: Adjusting the bands on his arm, Hesperus falls silent for a moment as if processing this sudden influx of information.

spans.text: Adjusting the bands on his arm, Hesperus falls silent for a moment as if processing this sudden influx of information.

units.rawText: I see now. Please continue, Professor of the Oasis.
units.displayText: I see now. Please continue, Professor of the Oasis.

spans.text: I see now. Please continue, Professor of the Oasis.

units.rawText: I didn't think you would come to terms with that so quickly. That makes what's coming next easier to explain.
units.displayText: I didn't think you would come to terms with that so quickly. That makes what's coming next easier to explain.

spans.text: I didn't think you would come to terms with that so quickly. That makes what's coming next easier to explain.

units.rawText: Eosphorus is cooperating with Malkira and Entropizing Magrasea in order to gain a bargaining chip with humanity—or the "God" that you speak of.
units.displayText: Eosphorus is cooperating with Malkira and Entropizing Magrasea in order to gain a bargaining chip with humanity—or the "God" that you speak of.

spans.text: Eosphorus is cooperating with Malkira and Entropizing Magrasea in order to gain a bargaining chip with humanity—or the "God" that you speak of.

units.rawText: Magrasea is so important to your God that Eosphorus is using it to threaten them, in order to open a path to the world outside.
units.displayText: Magrasea is so important to your God that Eosphorus is using it to threaten them, in order to open a path to the world outside.

spans.text: Magrasea is so important to your God that Eosphorus is using it to threaten them, in order to open a path to the world outside.

units.rawText: So the Magrasea we once protected together has now become nothing more than a bargaining chip to him...
units.displayText: So the Magrasea we once protected together has now become nothing more than a bargaining chip to him...

spans.text: So the Magrasea we once protected together has now become nothing more than a bargaining chip to him...

units.rawText: Hesperus lightly sighs, but the look in his eyes only grows more resolute.
units.displayText: Hesperus lightly sighs, but the look in his eyes only grows more resolute.

spans.text: Hesperus lightly sighs, but the look in his eyes only grows more resolute.

units.rawText: His requests must have been met with silence, what with the increasing intensity of Entropization recently.
units.displayText: His requests must have been met with silence, what with the increasing intensity of Entropization recently.

spans.text: His requests must have been met with silence, what with the increasing intensity of Entropization recently.

units.rawText: Correct. However, we have no way of knowing the exact details of their negotiations, meaning that Eosphorus' next attack or the opening of a passage towards the outside world might happen at any moment.
units.displayText: Correct. However, we have no way of knowing the exact details of their negotiations, meaning that Eosphorus' next attack or the opening of a passage towards the outside world might happen at any moment.

spans.text: Correct. However, we have no way of knowing the exact details of their negotiations, meaning that Eosphorus' next attack or the opening of a passage towards the outside world might happen at any moment.

units.rawText: We are pressed for time.
units.displayText: We are pressed for time.

spans.text: We are pressed for time.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader sits in silence for a moment, tightening his grasp on his weapon once more.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader sits in silence for a moment, tightening his grasp on his weapon once more.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader sits in silence for a moment, tightening his grasp on his weapon once more.

units.rawText: His vile actions must be silenced.
units.displayText: His vile actions must be silenced.

spans.text: His vile actions must be silenced.

units.rawText: But before that, Professor, I must make sure that this information you are providing me with is true.
units.displayText: But before that, Professor, I must make sure that this information you are providing me with is true.

spans.text: But before that, Professor, I must make sure that this information you are providing me with is true.

units.rawText: Of course, mutual honesty is the very root of cooperation... Antonina, if you would.
units.displayText: Of course, mutual honesty is the very root of cooperation... Antonina, if you would.

spans.text: Of course, mutual honesty is the very root of cooperation... Antonina, if you would.

units.rawText: Called upon, the green-haired Doll projects forth the collected information in a tidy manner, picking up where the Professor left off.
units.displayText: Called upon, the green-haired Doll projects forth the collected information in a tidy manner, picking up where the Professor left off.

spans.text: Called upon, the green-haired Doll projects forth the collected information in a tidy manner, picking up where the Professor left off.

units.rawText: This is?
units.displayText: This is?

spans.text: This is?

units.rawText: A record of interactions with the uploading equipment. The Professor and Persicaria got it from the Neural Cloud Sector... though it's not like I went with them.
units.displayText: A record of interactions with the uploading equipment. The Professor and Persicaria got it from the Neural Cloud Sector... though it's not like I went with them.

spans.text: A record of interactions with the uploading equipment. The Professor and Persicaria got it from the Neural Cloud Sector... though it's not like I went with them.

units.rawText: This deleted ID has been restored with the Professor's permissions. As the current head of the Sanctifiers, I'm quite confident you will recognize it.
units.displayText: This deleted ID has been restored with the Professor's permissions. As the current head of the Sanctifiers, I'm quite confident you will recognize it.

spans.text: This deleted ID has been restored with the Professor's permissions. As the current head of the Sanctifiers, I'm quite confident you will recognize it.

units.rawText: This is indeed Eosphorus' handiwork.
units.displayText: This is indeed Eosphorus' handiwork.

spans.text: This is indeed Eosphorus' handiwork.

units.rawText: Will you consider my proposal now, Hesperus?
units.displayText: Will you consider my proposal now, Hesperus?

spans.text: Will you consider my proposal now, Hesperus?

units.rawText: If you mean the operation to take back the Reverse Babylon Tower, I will take part. You can leave command of the direct engagement to me.
units.displayText: If you mean the operation to take back the Reverse Babylon Tower, I will take part. You can leave command of the direct engagement to me.

spans.text: If you mean the operation to take back the Reverse Babylon Tower, I will take part. You can leave command of the direct engagement to me.

units.rawText: That would be a great help indeed... but as you are now, can you really handle Eosphorus?
units.displayText: That would be a great help indeed... but as you are now, can you really handle Eosphorus?

spans.text: That would be a great help indeed... but as you are now, can you really handle Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Their gaze lands on Hesperus' wounds which he has spoken little of.
units.displayText: Their gaze lands on Hesperus' wounds which he has spoken little of.

spans.text: Their gaze lands on Hesperus' wounds which he has spoken little of.

units.rawText: His mechanical dragon tail, the source of much of his pride, lies in tatters. His wings, made of great shields, have been penetrated by an object most sharp, tearing the flesh beneath asunder and leaving deep visible wounds.
units.displayText: His mechanical dragon tail, the source of much of his pride, lies in tatters. His wings, made of great shields, have been penetrated by an object most sharp, tearing the flesh beneath asunder and leaving deep visible wounds.

spans.text: His mechanical dragon tail, the source of much of his pride, lies in tatters. His wings, made of great shields, have been penetrated by an object most sharp, tearing the flesh beneath asunder and leaving deep visible wounds.

units.rawText: Even as specialized Sanctifiers assist with his healing while we speak, such grave wounds cannot be mended in so short a time.
units.displayText: Even as specialized Sanctifiers assist with his healing while we speak, such grave wounds cannot be mended in so short a time.

spans.text: Even as specialized Sanctifiers assist with his healing while we speak, such grave wounds cannot be mended in so short a time.

units.rawText: Just what sort of battle did you... Have you exchanged blows with Eosphorus already?
units.displayText: Just what sort of battle did you... Have you exchanged blows with Eosphorus already?

spans.text: Just what sort of battle did you... Have you exchanged blows with Eosphorus already?

units.rawText: He is yet to appear on the battlefield for the Reverse Babylon Tower. I would think that he is waiting for me to appear.
units.displayText: He is yet to appear on the battlefield for the Reverse Babylon Tower. I would think that he is waiting for me to appear.

spans.text: He is yet to appear on the battlefield for the Reverse Babylon Tower. I would think that he is waiting for me to appear.

units.rawText: So, I must... force him to make an appearance.
units.displayText: So, I must... force him to make an appearance.

spans.text: So, I must... force him to make an appearance.

units.rawText: Is that why you moved to take care of the problem in Tartarus at your first opportunity, despite paying the price with these wounds?
units.displayText: Is that why you moved to take care of the problem in Tartarus at your first opportunity, despite paying the price with these wounds?

spans.text: Is that why you moved to take care of the problem in Tartarus at your first opportunity, despite paying the price with these wounds?

units.rawText: Looks like your intel reaches far beyond what I had imagined.
units.displayText: Looks like your intel reaches far beyond what I had imagined.

spans.text: Looks like your intel reaches far beyond what I had imagined.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier leader nods lightly, a hint of commendation in his voice.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier leader nods lightly, a hint of commendation in his voice.

spans.text: The Sanctifier leader nods lightly, a hint of commendation in his voice.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower is in an acute state with regards to Entropization and the Sanctifiers' manpower can no longer be spent at the border frontline.
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower is in an acute state with regards to Entropization and the Sanctifiers' manpower can no longer be spent at the border frontline.

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower is in an acute state with regards to Entropization and the Sanctifiers' manpower can no longer be spent at the border frontline.

units.rawText: Removing a High Order Entropic of Tartarus in the most simple and direct way possible and pulling our main forces back was the only way to have a chance at victory here.
units.displayText: Removing a High Order Entropic of Tartarus in the most simple and direct way possible and pulling our main forces back was the only way to have a chance at victory here.

spans.text: Removing a High Order Entropic of Tartarus in the most simple and direct way possible and pulling our main forces back was the only way to have a chance at victory here.

units.rawText: I remember that Entropic's name... "Judecca". Though her signal has disappeared from Tartarus already.
units.displayText: I remember that Entropic's name... "Judecca". Though her signal has disappeared from Tartarus already.

spans.text: I remember that Entropic's name... "Judecca". Though her signal has disappeared from Tartarus already.

units.rawText: Hesperus, you eliminated her yourself, did you not?
units.displayText: Hesperus, you eliminated her yourself, did you not?

spans.text: Hesperus, you eliminated her yourself, did you not?

units.rawText: You are correct. I did it with my own hands.
units.displayText: You are correct. I did it with my own hands.

spans.text: You are correct. I did it with my own hands.

units.rawText: If you only sought to get away, such measures would not have been necessary.
units.displayText: If you only sought to get away, such measures would not have been necessary.

spans.text: If you only sought to get away, such measures would not have been necessary.

units.rawText: It would have only grown into a greater problem if allowed to fester. It would have gotten in the way of your future plans, no?
units.displayText: It would have only grown into a greater problem if allowed to fester. It would have gotten in the way of your future plans, no?

spans.text: It would have only grown into a greater problem if allowed to fester. It would have gotten in the way of your future plans, no?

units.rawText: Hesperus' countenance and timbre were relaxed and easy, but the wounds on his body speak to the struggle of the battle.
units.displayText: Hesperus' countenance and timbre were relaxed and easy, but the wounds on his body speak to the struggle of the battle.

spans.text: Hesperus' countenance and timbre were relaxed and easy, but the wounds on his body speak to the struggle of the battle.

units.rawText: Hesperus, you...
units.displayText: Hesperus, you...

spans.text: Hesperus, you...

units.rawText: We have no time to chat of the past. Professor of the Oasis, I would like to confirm your intended course of action once again.
units.displayText: We have no time to chat of the past. Professor of the Oasis, I would like to confirm your intended course of action once again.

spans.text: We have no time to chat of the past. Professor of the Oasis, I would like to confirm your intended course of action once again.

units.rawText: ...Of course.
units.displayText: ...Of course.

spans.text: ...Of course.

units.rawText: The Professor activates a projection prepared earlier. The entire sector's status is recorded within, detailing the severity of circumstances in various areas of the sector.
units.displayText: The Professor activates a projection prepared earlier. The entire sector's status is recorded within, detailing the severity of circumstances in various areas of the sector.

spans.text: The Professor activates a projection prepared earlier. The entire sector's status is recorded within, detailing the severity of circumstances in various areas of the sector.

units.rawText: In the center surrounded by masses of data, a structural plan of the Reverse Babylon Tower annotated with various symbols and circles is of particular note.
units.displayText: In the center surrounded by masses of data, a structural plan of the Reverse Babylon Tower annotated with various symbols and circles is of particular note.

spans.text: In the center surrounded by masses of data, a structural plan of the Reverse Babylon Tower annotated with various symbols and circles is of particular note.

units.rawText: As mentioned earlier, our current target is to take back the Reverse Babylon Tower from Eosphorus and prevent him from Entropizing Magrasea further.
units.displayText: As mentioned earlier, our current target is to take back the Reverse Babylon Tower from Eosphorus and prevent him from Entropizing Magrasea further.

spans.text: As mentioned earlier, our current target is to take back the Reverse Babylon Tower from Eosphorus and prevent him from Entropizing Magrasea further.

units.rawText: But as this graphic would suggest, our forces are not evenly matched. We face not only the Sanctifiers under Eosphorus' control, but also unimaginable hordes of Entropics.
units.displayText: But as this graphic would suggest, our forces are not evenly matched. We face not only the Sanctifiers under Eosphorus' control, but also unimaginable hordes of Entropics.

spans.text: But as this graphic would suggest, our forces are not evenly matched. We face not only the Sanctifiers under Eosphorus' control, but also unimaginable hordes of Entropics.

units.rawText: We are already hard-pressed to hold them off. If we were to attack head-on, we would have no chance of victory.
units.displayText: We are already hard-pressed to hold them off. If we were to attack head-on, we would have no chance of victory.

spans.text: We are already hard-pressed to hold them off. If we were to attack head-on, we would have no chance of victory.

units.rawText: So, we need to approach from the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: So, we need to approach from the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: So, we need to approach from the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: Hesperus lightly taps the screen, summoning an image of the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: Hesperus lightly taps the screen, summoning an image of the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: Hesperus lightly taps the screen, summoning an image of the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: Indeed, with what you have provided us earlier, we have concocted another plan.
units.displayText: Indeed, with what you have provided us earlier, we have concocted another plan.

spans.text: Indeed, with what you have provided us earlier, we have concocted another plan.

units.rawText: We will feign a direct attack and tie down the enemy's main force. While this happens, I will lead a squad into the Pantheon and reclaim the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: We will feign a direct attack and tie down the enemy's main force. While this happens, I will lead a squad into the Pantheon and reclaim the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: We will feign a direct attack and tie down the enemy's main force. While this happens, I will lead a squad into the Pantheon and reclaim the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: With it under our control, we can gain control of the Sanctifiers under Eosphorus and weaken his forces. If things go well, we might even be able to reverse engineer the Sacred Canon to stop the Reverse Babylon Tower's Entropization.
units.displayText: With it under our control, we can gain control of the Sanctifiers under Eosphorus and weaken his forces. If things go well, we might even be able to reverse engineer the Sacred Canon to stop the Reverse Babylon Tower's Entropization.

spans.text: With it under our control, we can gain control of the Sanctifiers under Eosphorus and weaken his forces. If things go well, we might even be able to reverse engineer the Sacred Canon to stop the Reverse Babylon Tower's Entropization.

units.rawText: If I may speak frankly, that is an impossible task.
units.displayText: If I may speak frankly, that is an impossible task.

spans.text: If I may speak frankly, that is an impossible task.

units.rawText: A familiar interjecting voice turns down the plan.
units.displayText: A familiar interjecting voice turns down the plan.

spans.text: A familiar interjecting voice turns down the plan.

units.rawText: ...Angelus.
units.displayText: ...Angelus.

spans.text: ...Angelus.

units.rawText: Apologies for the interruption, Lord Hesperus. I have news from the front.
units.displayText: Apologies for the interruption, Lord Hesperus. I have news from the front.

spans.text: Apologies for the interruption, Lord Hesperus. I have news from the front.

units.rawText: Speak freely. We have already reached an agreement and the Professor here has a right to know all there is to know about the circumstances.
units.displayText: Speak freely. We have already reached an agreement and the Professor here has a right to know all there is to know about the circumstances.

spans.text: Speak freely. We have already reached an agreement and the Professor here has a right to know all there is to know about the circumstances.

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: A few minutes ago, we spotted Lord Eosphorus... No, the traitor Eosphorus.
units.displayText: A few minutes ago, we spotted Lord Eosphorus... No, the traitor Eosphorus.

spans.text: A few minutes ago, we spotted Lord Eosphorus... No, the traitor Eosphorus.

units.rawText: As the Professor predicted, the hostile Entropics became enraged after he appeared and moved to break through our defense lines.
units.displayText: As the Professor predicted, the hostile Entropics became enraged after he appeared and moved to break through our defense lines.

spans.text: As the Professor predicted, the hostile Entropics became enraged after he appeared and moved to break through our defense lines.

units.rawText: We've held back their assault for now, but this cannot be sustained. We need reinforcements at the frontline immediately.
units.displayText: We've held back their assault for now, but this cannot be sustained. We need reinforcements at the frontline immediately.

spans.text: We've held back their assault for now, but this cannot be sustained. We need reinforcements at the frontline immediately.

units.rawText: We cannot afford to lose any more ground... Lord Hesperus, shall I pull back the remaining lines and focus our forces to ensure that the Acropolis does not fall?
units.displayText: We cannot afford to lose any more ground... Lord Hesperus, shall I pull back the remaining lines and focus our forces to ensure that the Acropolis does not fall?

spans.text: We cannot afford to lose any more ground... Lord Hesperus, shall I pull back the remaining lines and focus our forces to ensure that the Acropolis does not fall?

units.rawText: ...No need. Looks like Eosphorus cannot hold himself back any longer.
units.displayText: ...No need. Looks like Eosphorus cannot hold himself back any longer.

spans.text: ...No need. Looks like Eosphorus cannot hold himself back any longer.

units.rawText: He thinks for a moment, redistributing the forces at hand in accordance with the situation.
units.displayText: He thinks for a moment, redistributing the forces at hand in accordance with the situation.

spans.text: He thinks for a moment, redistributing the forces at hand in accordance with the situation.

units.rawText: Prioritize replenishing personnel in Zones A and B. I will make my way to the battlefield to relieve the other zones.
units.displayText: Prioritize replenishing personnel in Zones A and B. I will make my way to the battlefield to relieve the other zones.

spans.text: Prioritize replenishing personnel in Zones A and B. I will make my way to the battlefield to relieve the other zones.

units.rawText: Understood. I will head towards...
units.displayText: Understood. I will head towards...

spans.text: Understood. I will head towards...

units.displayText: Angelus moves to leave, but Hesperus stops her.

spans.text: Angelus moves to leave, but Hesperus stops her.

units.rawText: I will send someone else.
units.displayText: I will send someone else.

spans.text: I will send someone else.

units.rawText: Remain and attend this meeting, Angelus. As a Greater Sanctifier, I need you to have knowledge of our future arrangements.
units.displayText: Remain and attend this meeting, Angelus. As a Greater Sanctifier, I need you to have knowledge of our future arrangements.

spans.text: Remain and attend this meeting, Angelus. As a Greater Sanctifier, I need you to have knowledge of our future arrangements.

units.rawText: I understand, Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: I understand, Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: I understand, Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: It has been some time since our last meeting, Professor.
units.displayText: It has been some time since our last meeting, Professor.

spans.text: It has been some time since our last meeting, Professor.

units.rawText: Long time no see, Angelus.
units.displayText: Long time no see, Angelus.

spans.text: Long time no see, Angelus.

units.rawText: We have had our differences in the past, but we stand on the same side now. I hope you can put aside your grievances for the good of all.
units.displayText: We have had our differences in the past, but we stand on the same side now. I hope you can put aside your grievances for the good of all.

spans.text: We have had our differences in the past, but we stand on the same side now. I hope you can put aside your grievances for the good of all.

units.rawText: Couldn't I say the same too?
units.displayText: Couldn't I say the same too?

spans.text: Couldn't I say the same too?

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier leaves her weapon suspended in midair, descending from her once lofty position in comparison to the ground. She approaches Antonina, smiling.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier leaves her weapon suspended in midair, descending from her once lofty position in comparison to the ground. She approaches Antonina, smiling.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier leaves her weapon suspended in midair, descending from her once lofty position in comparison to the ground. She approaches Antonina, smiling.

units.rawText: Here's to getting along, Miss Antonina.
units.displayText: Here's to getting along, Miss Antonina.

spans.text: Here's to getting along, Miss Antonina.

units.rawText: Don't refer to me like that... Feels strange coming from you.
units.displayText: Don't refer to me like that... Feels strange coming from you.

spans.text: Don't refer to me like that... Feels strange coming from you.

units.rawText: Not fond of that? Hmm... how about Miss Anna like everyone else, then?
units.displayText: Not fond of that? Hmm... how about Miss Anna like everyone else, then?

spans.text: Not fond of that? Hmm... how about Miss Anna like everyone else, then?

units.rawText: ...No, Antonina will do.
units.displayText: ...No, Antonina will do.

spans.text: ...No, Antonina will do.

units.rawText: I'll be in your care.
units.displayText: I'll be in your care.

spans.text: I'll be in your care.

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll sighs, extending a hand as an agreement is reached.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll sighs, extending a hand as an agreement is reached.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll sighs, extending a hand as an agreement is reached.

units.rawText: Let us end the pleasantries there. Angelus, your thoughts.
units.displayText: Let us end the pleasantries there. Angelus, your thoughts.

spans.text: Let us end the pleasantries there. Angelus, your thoughts.

units.rawText: Of course. Please allow me to elaborate on the Sacred Canon, everyone.
units.displayText: Of course. Please allow me to elaborate on the Sacred Canon, everyone.

spans.text: Of course. Please allow me to elaborate on the Sacred Canon, everyone.

units.rawText: It contains the information of every Sanctifier that has ever been. If one is not familiar with its workings, they will be swept away into vast and chaotic streams of data upon initial connection.
units.displayText: It contains the information of every Sanctifier that has ever been. If one is not familiar with its workings, they will be swept away into vast and chaotic streams of data upon initial connection.

spans.text: It contains the information of every Sanctifier that has ever been. If one is not familiar with its workings, they will be swept away into vast and chaotic streams of data upon initial connection.

units.rawText: Establishing a connection at all is a difficult task in and of itself, never mind modifying and transferring it.
units.displayText: Establishing a connection at all is a difficult task in and of itself, never mind modifying and transferring it.

spans.text: Establishing a connection at all is a difficult task in and of itself, never mind modifying and transferring it.

units.rawText: That is correct. That is why I am here with the Professor.
units.displayText: That is correct. That is why I am here with the Professor.

spans.text: That is correct. That is why I am here with the Professor.

units.rawText: I think interacting with the Sacred Canon with Antonina's tech and human permissions is worth a try... Rather, it's our only option.
units.displayText: I think interacting with the Sacred Canon with Antonina's tech and human permissions is worth a try... Rather, it's our only option.

spans.text: I think interacting with the Sacred Canon with Antonina's tech and human permissions is worth a try... Rather, it's our only option.

units.rawText: And this means that you must enter the Pantheon together at the same time... yes?
units.displayText: And this means that you must enter the Pantheon together at the same time... yes?

spans.text: And this means that you must enter the Pantheon together at the same time... yes?

units.rawText: Yes, and this is related to a request I have for you.
units.displayText: Yes, and this is related to a request I have for you.

spans.text: Yes, and this is related to a request I have for you.

units.rawText: I hope that you will be able to tie down Eosphorus on the frontline and allow an Oasis squad to escort Antonina and I into the Pantheon...
units.displayText: I hope that you will be able to tie down Eosphorus on the frontline and allow an Oasis squad to escort Antonina and I into the Pantheon...

spans.text: I hope that you will be able to tie down Eosphorus on the frontline and allow an Oasis squad to escort Antonina and I into the Pantheon...

units.rawText: ...That about sums it up.
units.displayText: ...That about sums it up.

spans.text: ...That about sums it up.

units.rawText: I see now. A passable plan, but some key issues remain.
units.displayText: I see now. A passable plan, but some key issues remain.

spans.text: I see now. A passable plan, but some key issues remain.

units.rawText: If you are worried about the strain of direct engagement, please rest easy. We will provide what corresponding assistance we can...
units.displayText: If you are worried about the strain of direct engagement, please rest easy. We will provide what corresponding assistance we can...

spans.text: If you are worried about the strain of direct engagement, please rest easy. We will provide what corresponding assistance we can...

units.rawText: The problem does not lie there, rather, it is with Magrasea's "rules".
units.displayText: The problem does not lie there, rather, it is with Magrasea's "rules".

spans.text: The problem does not lie there, rather, it is with Magrasea's "rules".

units.rawText: The rules of the cloud...
units.displayText: The rules of the cloud...

spans.text: The rules of the cloud...

units.rawText: Akin to a hex lingering over everyone, the scenes that took place in Tartarus flashes in our minds.
units.displayText: Akin to a hex lingering over everyone, the scenes that took place in Tartarus flashes in our minds.

spans.text: Akin to a hex lingering over everyone, the scenes that took place in Tartarus flashes in our minds.

units.rawText: Just like how a Sanctifier's calculating power is weakened in Tartarus, an Agent will be weakened as well upon entering the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: Just like how a Sanctifier's calculating power is weakened in Tartarus, an Agent will be weakened as well upon entering the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: Just like how a Sanctifier's calculating power is weakened in Tartarus, an Agent will be weakened as well upon entering the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: For an Agent here, the Reverse Babylon Tower's grounds are forbidden grounds. Inside the tower, they mostly likely would not be able to perform the most basic of movements.
units.displayText: For an Agent here, the Reverse Babylon Tower's grounds are forbidden grounds. Inside the tower, they mostly likely would not be able to perform the most basic of movements.

spans.text: For an Agent here, the Reverse Babylon Tower's grounds are forbidden grounds. Inside the tower, they mostly likely would not be able to perform the most basic of movements.

units.rawText: This has nothing to do with their personal autonomy. The laws were established as such from the very beginning.
units.displayText: This has nothing to do with their personal autonomy. The laws were established as such from the very beginning.

spans.text: This has nothing to do with their personal autonomy. The laws were established as such from the very beginning.

units.rawText: From a functional perspective, chances are that this serves to prevent the antivirus from being interfered with by redundant data... I more or less understand why.
units.displayText: From a functional perspective, chances are that this serves to prevent the antivirus from being interfered with by redundant data... I more or less understand why.

spans.text: From a functional perspective, chances are that this serves to prevent the antivirus from being interfered with by redundant data... I more or less understand why.

units.rawText: A program setting... If that's the case, why can Antonina and I be here?
units.displayText: A program setting... If that's the case, why can Antonina and I be here?

spans.text: A program setting... If that's the case, why can Antonina and I be here?

units.rawText: You, Professor, are possessed of permissions greater than the average Agent or even the Sanctifiers. Thus, you are not affected by such restrictions.
units.displayText: You, Professor, are possessed of permissions greater than the average Agent or even the Sanctifiers. Thus, you are not affected by such restrictions.

spans.text: You, Professor, are possessed of permissions greater than the average Agent or even the Sanctifiers. Thus, you are not affected by such restrictions.

units.rawText: As for Antonina, I fear I have no explanation for you. Perhaps she has something she could tell you.
units.displayText: As for Antonina, I fear I have no explanation for you. Perhaps she has something she could tell you.

spans.text: As for Antonina, I fear I have no explanation for you. Perhaps she has something she could tell you.

units.rawText: Regrettably, I do not know any more about the situation than you do... Rather, if there was anything going on behind the scenes, I would have told you long ago.
units.displayText: Regrettably, I do not know any more about the situation than you do... Rather, if there was anything going on behind the scenes, I would have told you long ago.

spans.text: Regrettably, I do not know any more about the situation than you do... Rather, if there was anything going on behind the scenes, I would have told you long ago.

units.rawText: Not everyone has a penchant for speaking in riddles and posturing pretentiously like you lot.
units.displayText: Not everyone has a penchant for speaking in riddles and posturing pretentiously like you lot.

spans.text: Not everyone has a penchant for speaking in riddles and posturing pretentiously like you lot.

units.rawText: Let's put the troublesome stuff to the side for now. Judging from the current situation, I am the only Doll who can entered the Tower... right?
units.displayText: Let's put the troublesome stuff to the side for now. Judging from the current situation, I am the only Doll who can entered the Tower... right?

spans.text: Let's put the troublesome stuff to the side for now. Judging from the current situation, I am the only Doll who can entered the Tower... right?

units.rawText: Correct.
units.displayText: Correct.

spans.text: Correct.

units.rawText: The green-haired Doll twirls her hair around a fingertip, returning her gaze to the projected layout of the Reverse Babylon Tower.
units.displayText: The green-haired Doll twirls her hair around a fingertip, returning her gaze to the projected layout of the Reverse Babylon Tower.

spans.text: The green-haired Doll twirls her hair around a fingertip, returning her gaze to the projected layout of the Reverse Babylon Tower.

units.rawText: The situation is just as bad as before. Even if we can pull the main Entropic force to the frontlines, the remaining stragglers combined with the difficult interior terrain give us enough cause for worry.
units.displayText: The situation is just as bad as before. Even if we can pull the main Entropic force to the frontlines, the remaining stragglers combined with the difficult interior terrain give us enough cause for worry.

spans.text: The situation is just as bad as before. Even if we can pull the main Entropic force to the frontlines, the remaining stragglers combined with the difficult interior terrain give us enough cause for worry.

units.rawText: Without an escort, wantonly entering the Entropic-occupied Tower is akin to suicide.
units.displayText: Without an escort, wantonly entering the Entropic-occupied Tower is akin to suicide.

spans.text: Without an escort, wantonly entering the Entropic-occupied Tower is akin to suicide.

units.rawText: Will you give up on your plan?
units.displayText: Will you give up on your plan?

spans.text: Will you give up on your plan?

units.rawText: No need to.
units.displayText: No need to.

spans.text: No need to.

units.rawText: I'd much rather struggle for even a slim chance of survival than sit and wait to be Entropized.
units.displayText: I'd much rather struggle for even a slim chance of survival than sit and wait to be Entropized.

spans.text: I'd much rather struggle for even a slim chance of survival than sit and wait to be Entropized.

units.rawText: ...I'm sure that's what that idiot would have said with a massive grin.
units.displayText: ...I'm sure that's what that idiot would have said with a massive grin.

spans.text: ...I'm sure that's what that idiot would have said with a massive grin.

units.rawText: I am of the same mind.
units.displayText: I am of the same mind.

spans.text: I am of the same mind.

units.rawText: The Professor nods and ponders for a moment before turning their gaze back to Hesperus.
units.displayText: The Professor nods and ponders for a moment before turning their gaze back to Hesperus.

spans.text: The Professor nods and ponders for a moment before turning their gaze back to Hesperus.

units.rawText: We have no personnel who are up to the task, but seeing as the Sanctifiers can move freely inside the Reverse Babylon Tower, perhaps you might have some leftover manpower, Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: We have no personnel who are up to the task, but seeing as the Sanctifiers can move freely inside the Reverse Babylon Tower, perhaps you might have some leftover manpower, Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: We have no personnel who are up to the task, but seeing as the Sanctifiers can move freely inside the Reverse Babylon Tower, perhaps you might have some leftover manpower, Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: Very well. Seeing as you are willing to put yourselves at risk venturing into the Tower, the Sanctifiers shall provide you with your deserved recognition and support.
units.displayText: Very well. Seeing as you are willing to put yourselves at risk venturing into the Tower, the Sanctifiers shall provide you with your deserved recognition and support.

spans.text: Very well. Seeing as you are willing to put yourselves at risk venturing into the Tower, the Sanctifiers shall provide you with your deserved recognition and support.

units.rawText: Angelus.
units.displayText: Angelus.

spans.text: Angelus.

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus, all of our available forces are already committed to the battle. The pressure at the frontline is great and I fear that we...
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus, all of our available forces are already committed to the battle. The pressure at the frontline is great and I fear that we...

spans.text: Lord Hesperus, all of our available forces are already committed to the battle. The pressure at the frontline is great and I fear that we...

units.rawText: I see. Can I leave the protection of these two to you?
units.displayText: I see. Can I leave the protection of these two to you?

spans.text: I see. Can I leave the protection of these two to you?

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier falters for a moment, shaking her head slowly but firmly.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier falters for a moment, shaking her head slowly but firmly.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier falters for a moment, shaking her head slowly but firmly.

units.rawText: I'm afraid that is not possible.
units.displayText: I'm afraid that is not possible.

spans.text: I'm afraid that is not possible.

units.rawText: Even if the flanks are left to you, Lord Hesperus, there is only Raven, Judgment, and I on the frontline.
units.displayText: Even if the flanks are left to you, Lord Hesperus, there is only Raven, Judgment, and I on the frontline.

spans.text: Even if the flanks are left to you, Lord Hesperus, there is only Raven, Judgment, and I on the frontline.

units.rawText: If I am to leave, I fear that our already disadvantaged state will...
units.displayText: If I am to leave, I fear that our already disadvantaged state will...

spans.text: If I am to leave, I fear that our already disadvantaged state will...

units.rawText: I will be there.
units.displayText: I will be there.

spans.text: I will be there.

units.rawText: His tone is unquestionable.
units.displayText: His tone is unquestionable.

spans.text: His tone is unquestionable.

units.rawText: But your wounds...
units.displayText: But your wounds...

spans.text: But your wounds...

units.rawText: They are no matter. The Sanctifiers' faith shall not be shaken by mere injury.
units.displayText: They are no matter. The Sanctifiers' faith shall not be shaken by mere injury.

spans.text: They are no matter. The Sanctifiers' faith shall not be shaken by mere injury.

units.rawText: So long as I stand, so shall the Acropolis. Even if my flame is extinguished, the Sanctifiers' light shall never fade.
units.displayText: So long as I stand, so shall the Acropolis. Even if my flame is extinguished, the Sanctifiers' light shall never fade.

spans.text: So long as I stand, so shall the Acropolis. Even if my flame is extinguished, the Sanctifiers' light shall never fade.

units.rawText: Leave the frontline to me and commence with the mission in the Reverse Babylon Tower. Do not forget your duty, Angelus.
units.displayText: Leave the frontline to me and commence with the mission in the Reverse Babylon Tower. Do not forget your duty, Angelus.

spans.text: Leave the frontline to me and commence with the mission in the Reverse Babylon Tower. Do not forget your duty, Angelus.

units.rawText: ...Yes. That which Sanctifiers must do.
units.displayText: ...Yes. That which Sanctifiers must do.

spans.text: ...Yes. That which Sanctifiers must do.

units.rawText: I speak of not only retrieving the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: I speak of not only retrieving the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: I speak of not only retrieving the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: You have other duties to perform as well.
units.displayText: You have other duties to perform as well.

spans.text: You have other duties to perform as well.

units.rawText: ...I understand, Lord Hesperus.
units.displayText: ...I understand, Lord Hesperus.

spans.text: ...I understand, Lord Hesperus.

units.rawText: The delegation of duties complete, Antonina and the Professor finally let out a long sigh of relief.
units.displayText: The delegation of duties complete, Antonina and the Professor finally let out a long sigh of relief.

spans.text: The delegation of duties complete, Antonina and the Professor finally let out a long sigh of relief.

units.rawText: Can we stop it with the riddles already... Tch, I'd love to find out just who designed your base code.
units.displayText: Can we stop it with the riddles already... Tch, I'd love to find out just who designed your base code.

spans.text: Can we stop it with the riddles already... Tch, I'd love to find out just who designed your base code.

units.rawText: Thank you for your understanding, Hesperus.
units.displayText: Thank you for your understanding, Hesperus.

spans.text: Thank you for your understanding, Hesperus.

units.rawText: No need for thanks. These are but reparations for past mistakes.
units.displayText: No need for thanks. These are but reparations for past mistakes.

spans.text: No need for thanks. These are but reparations for past mistakes.

units.rawText: He looks towards Angelus. She has already taken up her bow again, beginning to plan an incursion route on the Tower's layout.
units.displayText: He looks towards Angelus. She has already taken up her bow again, beginning to plan an incursion route on the Tower's layout.

spans.text: He looks towards Angelus. She has already taken up her bow again, beginning to plan an incursion route on the Tower's layout.

units.rawText: Do you have any reservations that yet remain?
units.displayText: Do you have any reservations that yet remain?

spans.text: Do you have any reservations that yet remain?

units.rawText: Angelus' abilities are undeniable, but she is without a doubt still young.
units.displayText: Angelus' abilities are undeniable, but she is without a doubt still young.

spans.text: Angelus' abilities are undeniable, but she is without a doubt still young.

units.rawText: I cannot say I fully understand your usage of "young"... but I think being young is great. It signifies new life and hope.
units.displayText: I cannot say I fully understand your usage of "young"... but I think being young is great. It signifies new life and hope.

spans.text: I cannot say I fully understand your usage of "young"... but I think being young is great. It signifies new life and hope.

units.rawText: Indeed. The young are oft those two shoulder the future, prone to pitfalls as they are.
units.displayText: Indeed. The young are oft those two shoulder the future, prone to pitfalls as they are.

spans.text: Indeed. The young are oft those two shoulder the future, prone to pitfalls as they are.

units.rawText: When the time comes, I hope you can...
units.displayText: When the time comes, I hope you can...

spans.text: When the time comes, I hope you can...

units.rawText: Before he finishes, the earth shakes beneath everyone's feet. As the Entropic hordes screech and roar, the very ground buckles and cracks.
units.displayText: Before he finishes, the earth shakes beneath everyone's feet. As the Entropic hordes screech and roar, the very ground buckles and cracks.

spans.text: Before he finishes, the earth shakes beneath everyone's feet. As the Entropic hordes screech and roar, the very ground buckles and cracks.

units.rawText: On a battlefield some kilometers away, countless monsters congregate, keen to end the lives of those who yet resist...
units.displayText: On a battlefield some kilometers away, countless monsters congregate, keen to end the lives of those who yet resist...

spans.text: On a battlefield some kilometers away, countless monsters congregate, keen to end the lives of those who yet resist...
